Apple Sends Spyware Alerts to Users in 110 Countries

Apple confirmed it sent spyware alerts to users in 110 countries on August 13. The notifications warned recipients that they were "personally targeted by a state-sponsored attacker." The company stated that it has no information to suggest that such attacks are related to the iPhone or Apple devices. The alerts were sent to users globally, with reports indicating a significant number of recipients.
